name: Gambler
lore: You are a skilled gambler who spends most of your time in casinos, bar rooms, and gambling dens. Are your activities legal, or do you break the law? Have you ever cheated in a game, or do you play by the rules? No matter what, your life has been one of excitement, chance, and danger.
skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, and Sleight of Hand
startingEquipment: A set of common clothes, a set of dice, a deck of playing cards, a lucky charm, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr.

feature.name: Let's Make It Interesting
feature.description: You can convince nearly anyone to put up something they aren't normally willing to part with (property or information) in a game of chance. Your GM might rule that they will only agree to a game of their choosing, and they may only agree if they feel the odds are in their favor.

suggestedCharacteristics: Gambling is your passion, for better or for worse. Most gamblers see their vices as virtues, and overlook things in their pursuit of the rush.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I like to impress everyone I meet with a simple trick or a quick joke.
I constantly make side bets on everything that happens around me.
No matter how high the stakes, I always appear calm.
I try to be unpredictable, so no one will know when I'm bluffing.
I never back down from a challenge.
I can't get satisfaction out of something if the stakes are too low.
I tend to make friends out of enemies, and enemies out of friends.
I prefer one game above all others.

idealOptions.name: Risk
idealOptions.description: Nothing worth doing is ever a sure thing. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Victory
idealOptions.description: Never make a bet unless you're sure you can win. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: Anything that isn't mine soon will be. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I share my winnings with the less fortunate. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Surprise
idealOptions.description: Life is a game worth playing, because you never know how the dice will land. (Any)

bondOptions.description: I owe a lot of money to the wrong kind of people.
I still keep the first coin I ever won. It's my good luck charm.
Most of my winnings go to my home.
Someday I will own my own casino.
I lost a large sum of money to a con artist; I seek to get it back.
I hide my gambling behind a normal life. My friends have no idea who I really am.

flawOptions.description: I can't step away from the table when I'm losing.
I spend money faster than I can make it.
Everyone has a price. Mine happens to be pretty low.
I assume everyone is hiding something from me.
I tend to value money more than people.
I like to think I could drink anyone under the table, but I'm really a lightweight.
